note: A 2024 literature review identified sparse hair in 26 of 28 reported individuals with Jaberi-Elahi syndrome (~93%), supporting its role as a high-sensitivity hallmark.

evidence.text: In a comprehensive literature review of 28 individuals with Jaberi-Elahi syndrome, sparse hair was documented in 26 of 28 patients (92.9%), ranking alongside motor development delay as the most frequent clinical manifestation.

source.title: Jaberi-Elahi syndrome: Exploring a novel GTPBP2 mutation and a literature review
source.quote: A large numbers of patients manifest motor development delay (26/28), sparse hair (26/28), and speech disorder (24/28).

evidence.text: A 4-month-old infant presenting with early-onset features of Jaberi-Elahi syndrome showed no overt ectodermal manifestations, consistent with ectodermal findings becoming prominent after early infancy.

source.title: A Novel Homozygous Frameshift GTPBP2 Variant in Jaberi-Elahi Syndrome: First Case Report from Türkiye
source.quote: We report a 4-month-old female infant born to consanguineous parents... No overt ectodermal abnormalities were observed.
